source.publication: 2025 MI-1040 Forms and Instructions (includes Form 4884 instructions)
source.section: MI-1040 lines 9a, 10, 13-17 (PDF page 10 Line 9a, Line 10, Line 17; PDF page 11 example: line 14 income subject to tax less line 15 exemptions = line 16 taxable income); no Schedule 1 additions or subtractions; PDF page 3 (rate 4.25%, exemption 5,800)

worked: Federal AGI = wages 90,000.00 + 22,000.00 + interest 1,000.00 = 113,000.00. Federal taxable income = 113,000.00 - federal standard deduction (31,500.00) = 81,500.00; given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored. Michigan: line 10 AGI 113,000.00; line 11 additions 0.00; line 13 subtractions 0.00 (both born after 1966, so no retirement subtraction or Michigan Standard Deduction; no Social Security); line 14 income subject to tax 113,000.00; line 9a/15 exemptions 2 x 5,800 = 11,600.00; line 16 taxable income 113,000.00 - 11,600.00 = 101,400.00. MI-1040 line 17 tax = 101,400.00 x 0.0425 = 4,309.50. No credits; state income tax 4,309.50.
